body_markdown: Ms. Margaret Hoor Han Lo has been our independent director and member of audit committee, compensation committee and nominating and corporate governance committee since June 2025. Ms. Lo is a seasoned investor with over 30 years of extensive experience in the real estate investments. She is also deeply committed to philanthropy, actively participating in various charitable initiatives and volunteer work.
